---
title: "GRCh38 Native EVN-versus-SVN Chromosome Learning Curves"
subtitle: "Native comparison | `r params$negative_kind` negative backgrounds"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    number_sections: true
    theme: cosmo
params:
  metrics_path: null
  negative_kind: null
  full_model_prefix: null
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,
                      fig.width=10, fig.height=7, dpi=120)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(gt); library(scales)})
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
          theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), legend.position="bottom"))
task_colors <- c(EVN="#0072B2", SVN="#D55E00")
```

```{r inputs, include=FALSE}
if (is.null(params$metrics_path) || is.null(params$negative_kind))
  stop("metrics_path and negative_kind are required")
metrics_path <- normalizePath(params$metrics_path, mustWork=TRUE)
all_metrics <- read.delim(metrics_path, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors=FALSE,
                          check.names=FALSE)
if (nrow(all_metrics) != 504) stop("Expected 504 source rows; found ", nrow(all_metrics))
x <- all_metrics |>
  filter(evaluation_mode == "native") |>
  mutate(Model=recode(model, lsgkm="LS-GKM", alphagenome="AlphaGenome"),
         Task=toupper(model_task),
         Split=factor(recode(split, train_100="Full training pool",
                             validation="Validation", test="Test"),
                      levels=c("Full training pool", "Validation", "Test")),
         ranking_error=1-auroc)
if (nrow(x) != 252) stop("Expected 252 native rows; found ", nrow(x))
has_full_model <- !is.null(params$full_model_prefix) && nzchar(params$full_model_prefix)
full_metrics <- NULL
if (has_full_model) {
  prefix <- params$full_model_prefix
  validation_json <- jsonlite::read_json(paste0(prefix, ".validation_metrics.json"), simplifyVector=TRUE)
  test_json <- jsonlite::read_json(paste0(prefix, ".test_metrics.json"), simplifyVector=TRUE)
  config <- jsonlite::read_json(paste0(prefix, ".config.json"), simplifyVector=TRUE)
  count_fasta <- function(path) as.integer(system(sprintf("grep -c '^>' %s", shQuote(path)), intern=TRUE))
  train_total <- count_fasta(config$train_pos) + count_fasta(config$train_neg)
  make_row <- function(split, values) {
    tibble(Model="AlphaGenome", Task="EVN",
           Split=factor(split, levels=c("Full training pool","Validation","Test")),
           n_training_total=train_total, auroc=values$auroc, auprc=values$auprc,
           ranking_error=1-values$auroc)
  }
  full_metrics <- bind_rows(make_row("Validation", validation_json$validation),
                            make_row("Test", test_json$test))
}
metric_limits <- function(v) {
  span <- diff(range(v, na.rm=TRUE)); pad <- max(span*.08, .002)
  range(v, na.rm=TRUE) + c(-pad, pad)
}
native_plot <- function(metric, title, label) {
  limits_data <- x[[metric]]
  if (has_full_model) limits_data <- c(limits_data, full_metrics[[metric]])
  p <- ggplot(x, aes(n_training_total, .data[[metric]], color=Task, group=Task)) +
    geom_line(linewidth=.85) + geom_point(size=1.8) +
    facet_grid(Split ~ Model, scales="free_x") +
    scale_color_manual(values=task_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels=comma, expand=expansion(mult=c(.02,.03))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim=metric_limits(limits_data)) +
    labs(title=title, x="Cumulative training observations", y=label,
         color="Native task",
         caption=if (has_full_model) "Star: full cleaned-EVN AlphaGenome model" else NULL)
  if (has_full_model) {
    p <- p + geom_point(data=full_metrics,
                        aes(x=n_training_total, y=.data[[metric]], color=Task),
                        inherit.aes=FALSE, shape=8, size=4, stroke=1.1)
  }
  p
}
```

# Scope and interpretation

This report compares native enhancer-versus-negative (EVN) and
silencer-versus-negative (SVN) performance for LS-GKM and AlphaGenome using
`r params$negative_kind` genomic backgrounds. Chr1 is validation, chr2 is held-out
test, and training checkpoints cumulatively add chr3 through chrX.

EVN and SVN are different biological classification tasks, so vertical differences
describe task-specific performance and should not be interpreted as paired-locus
effects.

# AUROC learning curves

```{r auroc}
native_plot("auroc", "Native EVN and SVN AUROC", "AUROC")
```

# Average-precision learning curves

```{r auprc}
native_plot("auprc", "Native EVN and SVN average precision", "Average Precision")
```

# AUROC ranking-error curves

```{r ranking}
native_plot("ranking_error", "Native EVN and SVN AUROC ranking error", "1 - AUROC")
```

# Full-training comparison

```{r full}
x |> filter(checkpoint_index == max(checkpoint_index)) |>
  select(Model, Task, Split, n_training_total, n_evaluation_total, auroc, auprc) |>
  rename(`Training observations`=n_training_total,
         `Evaluation observations`=n_evaluation_total,
         AUROC=auroc, `Average Precision`=auprc) |>
  arrange(Model, Split, Task) |>
  gt(groupname_col="Model") |>
  tab_header(title="Final chr3-through-chrX native models") |>
  fmt_integer(columns=c(`Training observations`, `Evaluation observations`)) |>
  fmt_number(columns=c(AUROC, `Average Precision`), decimals=3)
```

# Reproducibility notes

- The report uses only native evaluations from the shared native-versus-cross metric table.
- Both methods and all three evaluation splits use common metric-axis ranges.
- Test data are used only for final evaluation.
- The obsolete outer-fold stability analysis is intentionally omitted.
